contents.notes: Replace with an explicit measured hardware profile before publishing benchmark results.

manifest.hypothesis: Dependency-aware invalidation avoids unnecessary recomputation while preserving exact semantics: SemanticHost::prepare_delta marks the transitive reverse closure of a change, over the old and the new dependency edges (the definition of the oracle's structural closure; the harness cannot tell the two walks apart), as affected, hands back exactly that set from apply_prepared and apply_delta, keeps the dependency sets the oracle's edges prescribe, and evicts the affected derived values, so that arm A (evaluate the harness-supplied derivation only for the derived keys marked affected, write the results back) leaves the host in the same committed state, key by key, as arm G (global recomputation of every derived key after every delta) and as an independent oracle, while on the local-change class (deltas whose oracle structural closure holds at least one derived key and at most 5% of the derived keys) evaluating at most 250 per mille as many derived keys as arm G. Graphs: seeded DAGs of 256, 1024 and 4096 keys of five topology classes (layered fan-in, deep chains, diamonds, hub-and-spoke, lossy min/parity derivations); update streams: leaf edits, hub edits, rewiring, key removal, no-op writes, mixed batches, cycle-creating attempts and MissingDependency probes. The recomputation is a pure derivation supplied by the harness (ptr-semdb has no query engine); the hub class is an ungated control; unnecessary invalidations (a recomputed key whose value did not change) are descriptive beyond a floor of one (a coverage prerequisite that shows the lossy derivations absorbed changes), because SemDB has no early cutoff; overinvalidation_local_permille (arm A's evaluations over the closure of the local-change deltas, 1000 for an exact host) and wall-clock times are descriptive.

manifest.baseline: global recomputation of every derived key after every delta
manifest.falsification: The run is invalid (vacuous) and counts as falsified if any coverage prerequisite is unmet: deltas < 1000, topology_classes < 5, max_closure_depth < 4, rewires < 1, removals < 1, noop_writes < 1, cycle_attempts < 1, missing_dependency_probes < 1, hub_deltas < 1, lossy_class_deltas < 1, local_class_deltas < 100 (the local-change class is empty), value_changed_total < 1, unnecessary_invalidations < 1 or evals_global < 1. Falsified if any of: missed_invalidations > 0 (a derived key whose fresh value changed that the host did not mark affected, or a derived value still present after prepare_delta whose fresh oracle value differs); closure_mismatches > 0 (the host's affected set differs from the oracle's structural closure over the old and the new edges, or the set apply_prepared / apply_delta returns differs from the preparation's affected set (phase 1) or from the oracle's closure of the recomputed keys (phase 2)); dependency_mismatches > 0 (after a delta, or after loading a graph, the host stores a dependency set the oracle's edges do not prescribe, for some key); semantic_divergences > 0 (the host's committed state after both phases differs from the global recomputation's, by key or by value); noop_revision_bumps > 0 (a delta that changes nothing advanced the revision); revision_mismatches > 0 (the host's revision after either phase is not the oracle's); unexpected_refusals > 0 (the host refused, while loading a graph, in prepare_delta, in apply_prepared or in phase 2, a delta the oracle accepts, with an error that only a host defect can produce); cycle_attempts != cycle_refusals (a cycle-creating delta was not refused as CyclicDependency); missing_dependency_probes != missing_dependency_refusals (an upsert of a key with an input that holds nothing was not refused as MissingDependency); locality_ratio_permille_local > 250 (on the local-change class, arm A evaluated more than 250 per mille as many derived keys as arm G); any one of the 5 listed seeds misses any criterion above (every seed must pass). locality_ratio_permille_hub, overinvalidation_local_permille, the number of unnecessary invalidations beyond the floor, precision_value_permille and every wall-clock time are descriptive and never judged.
